name: Beastly Bonds
source:
Beastly Bonds is a visual novel / clicker game. Enjoy the company of your fellow Beasts as you get to experience scenarios through the main character's eyes!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/beastly-bonds-135557599/]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Beastly Bonds》是一款结合了点击玩法的视觉小说游戏。透过主角的双眼亲历丰富多彩的剧情场景，尽情享受与兽人伙伴们相伴的时光吧！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/beastly-bonds-135557599/]Patreon[/url]]
